items.title: Spy agency warns active Russian hackers targeting Australian industry
items.description: The Australian Signals Directorate says hackers are trying to access information through network devices, such as laptops, which use old software and predictable passwords.

items.title: What we know about the alleged murder of Jana Armstrong
items.description: The search for Toowoomba mother Jana Armstrong ended in tragedy. Here's what police say happened to the young mother.

items.title: Trump's IRS settlement tried to 'manipulate' court, judge says
items.description: US President Donald Trump's lawsuit against his own government over leaked tax records was an unparalleled exercise in self-dealing, a US judge says in a scathing ruling.

items.title: Former building CEO tells inquiry he tried to take his own life after CFMEU intimidation
items.description: The former boss of Master Builders Queensland has told an inquiry he tried to take his own life after a campaign of intimidation by the Construction, Forestry and Maritime Employees Union.

items.title: A 60-year-old law could decide if Australia gets billions in AI investments
items.description: Tens of billions of dollars in investment, and Australia's ambition to become a global AI power, could hinge on a law written in 1968 for an era of black-and-white television, film and radio.

items.title: Bird flu detection training to be rolled out to volunteers
items.description: Training to help volunteers identify potential cases of bird flu will be rolled out in South Australia, under a partnership between conservation groups and government.

items.title: Ex-cop turned missing persons expert says he may know where Peter Falconio is
items.description: Jim Whitehead has helped to close some of Australia's most high-profile missing persons cases, including those of Daniel Morcombe and Allison Baden-Clay. Now he is looking to help find the remains of British backpacker Peter Falconio.

items.title: Teen in life-threatening condition after Brisbane school stabbing
items.description: Emergency services were called to the Islamic College of Brisbane in Karawatha just before midday after reports of an altercation between two students.

items.title: Middle East 'chaos' could see millions of motorists slugged again as oil surges
items.description: The recent closure of the Strait of Hormuz saw the oil price lift, but buying in the market accelerated following Donald Trump's latest Truth Social post.

items.title: New Jewish students apprehensive about being on campus, commission hears
items.description: The president of a Jewish student body tells antisemitism royal commission he had a relatively untroubled childhood until he went to university.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
